An Indigenous standard population from the census

Source: R/census.R
cnsstd.Rd

The age structure of a group in a geography of the 2021 Census Indigenous Population Profile, as the standard of agestd or stdprev.

Usage

cnsstd(
  x,
  grp = "Indigenous identity",
  geo = "Canada",
  ages = c("0 to 4 years", "5 to 9 years", "10 to 14 years", "15 to 19 years",
    "20 to 24 years", "25 to 34 years", "35 to 44 years", "45 to 54 years",
    "55 to 64 years", "65 to 74 years", "75 years and over"),
  resid = "Total - Residence on or off reserve"
)

Arguments

x

A cnsprof.

grp

The group (default "Indigenous identity").

geo

The geography: its name (default "Canada") or, where names repeat, its DGUID.

ages

The age groups, as the profile names them.

resid

On or off reserve, in the tables that split it (default the total).

Value

A data frame: age, population, weight (shares summing to 1).

Details

Comparisons of First Nations, Metis and Inuit health are standardised to the Indigenous population's own, younger, age structure (Kumar and Tjepkema 2019): a standard as old as Canada's gives weight to ages where few Indigenous people are. This takes the population in private households of each age group (the profile's first characteristic) for the group and geography given. Age groups that do not overlap are chosen by default (0 to 4, 5 to 9, 10 to 14, 15 to 19, 20 to 24, 25 to 34, 35 to 44, 45 to 54, 55 to 64, 65 to 74, 75 and over); collapse them to the age groups of the rates being standardised.

References

Kumar MB, Tjepkema M (2019). Suicide among First Nations people, Metis and Inuit (2011-2016): findings from the 2011 Canadian Census Health and Environment Cohort (CanCHEC). Statistics Canada catalogue no. 99-011-X2019001.

See also

agestd, stdprev.

Examples

p <- cnsprof(indiex("censuspop"))
cnsstd(p)
#>                  age population     weight
#> 1       0 to 4 years     137510 0.07608819
#> 2       5 to 9 years     155565 0.08607853
#> 3     10 to 14 years     166135 0.09192722
#> 4     15 to 19 years     148820 0.08234633
#> 5     20 to 24 years     136070 0.07529140
#> 6     25 to 34 years     263655 0.14588780
#> 7     35 to 44 years     217990 0.12062006
#> 8     45 to 54 years     206360 0.11418485
#> 9     55 to 64 years     202785 0.11220670
#> 10    65 to 74 years     119410 0.06607295
#> 11 75 years and over      52945 0.02929597
